Name: Talmai, King of Geshur
Summary: Talmai, king of Geshur, was the father of Maacah, David's wife, and the grandfather of Absalom. Absalom fled to him for three years after murdering Amnon.
KeyStory: Talmai sheltered his grandson Absalom for three years after the murder of Amnon.
RelatedPeople: Maacah, Daughter of Talmai; Absalom; King David
LifeLesson: A grandfather's refuge can shelter a fugitive — and delay a reckoning.
